about.title: About me
about.intro: I build browser-based applications with JavaScript and Angular. For the Pokédex project, I solved the challenge of presenting large amounts of API data in a fast, clear, and responsive interface.
about.details: I fetched Pokémon data through the PokéAPI, implemented filtering and caching, and adapted the interface for mobile devices. The result is a responsive application that makes it easy to search and explore Pokémon.
about.statusValue: Open to remote work and collaboration

projects.pokedex: A Pokédex application with PokéAPI integration, dynamic loading of Pokémon data, filtering features, and responsive design.
projects.pollo: An interactive browser-based jump-and-run game featuring character animations, enemy AI, collision detection, and scoring system.
projects.join: A Kanban-based project management tool with task management, user assignment, and clear status views.
